description: Assess signups and gateway events for abuse risk, wait for pending assessments, page an account's history and record outcomes.
long_description: Assess a signup or gateway event, poll a pending assessment, page through an account's history, record what you later learned, rotate your API key, manage your webhook endpoints, and register hosted endpoints that answer your WorkOS or Auth0 sign-up and sign-in hooks. Every response carries X-Request-ID; every error is an RFC 9457 problem document. Keep the API key on your server.
name: noresponse

api_key.description: Your NoResponse API key (nrk_...). It stays on this computer and is sent only to api.noresponse.org.
api_key.title: API key

tools.name: create_assessment
tools.description:
Assess identifiers for a signup or gateway decision.

Returns within the deadline (500 ms at most) with a complete, partial or pending assessment: 200 carries complete or partial, 202 carries pending with Location and Retry-After. A pending answer has no recommendation; apply your own fallback for pending, 429, 503 or a timeout. risk.block says when your block threshold was reached. Requires the assess scope. Idempotency-Key is optional in the SDK and is bound to the body for 24 hours: the same key with the same body replays the latest assessment with Idempotent-Replayed: true and starts no new work; the same key with a different body answers 409 idempotency_key_reused. response_mode defaults to standard; detailed needs the detailed scope.

tools.name: get_assessment
tools.description:
Poll the authoritative assessment of one assessment.

Returns the highest assessment_version. Requires the assess or history scope. While status is pending, or partial with a source still running, the response carries Retry-After; poll no faster than it says. Another tenant's assessment, an unknown or expired assessment and a malformed assessment_id all answer 404 not_found. response_mode=detailed needs the detailed scope.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description:
Report what was later learned about an assessed account.

Records what you later learned about an assessed account: confirmed_abuse, account_takeover and chargeback report abuse; false_positive and legitimate withdraw your earlier report; unknown is recorded only. Outcomes are append-only and the latest one wins. Requires the assess scope. Idempotency-Key is optional in the SDK and handled as on POST /v1/assessments: a retry with the same key and body answers the same record with Idempotent-Replayed: true; a different body answers 409. An unknown, expired or foreign assessment answers 404 not_found.

tools.name: query_assessments
tools.description:
Page through one account's unexpired assessments.

History is a POST with account_id in the body so an account identifier stays out of URLs and access logs. Requires the history scope. Read-only and safe to retry. Newest first, each at its latest assessment_version. An account with no assessments answers 200 with empty items. The cursor is opaque and bound to your tenant and the account; a tampered or expired cursor answers 400 invalid_cursor. response_mode=detailed needs the detailed scope.

tools.name: create_integration
tools.description:
Register a hosted provider integration.

Registers a WorkOS or Auth0 integration and returns its hosted endpoint, url, so a sign-up or sign-in is scored with no server of your own. For WorkOS, send the Actions signing secret from the WorkOS dashboard and point the user registration and authentication Actions at url. For Auth0, the answer's secret is the shared secret of the NoResponse Auth0 Action, shown once: store it as an Action secret. hook_points defaults to both pre_registration and post_login; an event that is not listed is allowed without an assessment. The endpoint waits for the full assessment for at most 2.5 seconds (WorkOS) or 4.5 seconds (Auth0), denies only when risk.block is true and allows on any failure. Requires the integrations scope; at most 10 per account. Not idempotent: a retry after a lost answer registers another integration.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description:
List the tenant's integrations.

Every integration, oldest first. Listings carry no secrets. Requires the integrations scope.

tools.name: delete_integration
tools.description:
Delete an integration.

Removes the integration and its secrets; its endpoint answers 404 from then on, so remove the Action from the provider first. Requires the integrations scope. An unknown or already deleted integration answers 404.

tools.name: rotate_integration_secret
tools.description:
Replace an integration's secret.

For Auth0, send {} and the answer's secret is the new shared secret, shown once. For WorkOS, regenerate the Actions secret in the WorkOS dashboard and send it as signing_secret. The replaced secret is still accepted for 24 hours (previous_secret_expires_at). Requires the integrations scope. Not idempotent: a retry after a lost answer rotates again.

tools.name: list_webhook_endpoints
tools.description:
List the tenant's webhook endpoints.

Lists your webhook endpoints in every state, ordered by endpoint_id, with the ids of their signing keys and without secrets. Requires the webhooks scope.

tools.name: create_webhook_endpoint
tools.description:
Register a webhook endpoint.

Registers a webhook endpoint and returns it with its first signing secret, shown only in this answer: store it where your receiver reads it. The URL is https on port 443 or 8443 with a DNS host whose every address is public; it is checked now and on every delivery. The endpoint starts unverified and receives assessment events once it echoes an endpoint.verification challenge, which sendTestEvent sends. You can hold 5 endpoints. Requires the webhooks scope, and response_mode detailed also the detailed scope. Registration is not idempotent: a retry after a lost answer registers a second endpoint, which you can list and delete.

tools.name: delete_webhook_endpoint
tools.description:
Delete a webhook endpoint.

Deletes the endpoint and its signing keys. Deliveries still queued for it are dropped. Requires the webhooks scope. An endpoint that is already gone answers 404.

tools.name: rotate_webhook_signing_key
tools.description:
Rotate an endpoint's signing key.

Issues a new signing key for the endpoint and returns its secret once. Every delivery from now on is signed with it; the key it replaces keeps verifying for 7 days, so your receiver can hold both while it switches. Requires the webhooks scope. Rotation is not idempotent: a retry after a lost answer issues another key, which replaces the first.

tools.name: send_webhook_test_event
tools.description:
Send a test event to an endpoint.

endpoint.verification sends a signed challenge now and answers whether the endpoint echoed it within 5 seconds; an echo verifies the endpoint, including a disabled one. assessment.updated queues one signed event with test: true and a fixed example assessment in the endpoint's response mode, delivered and retried like any other event; the endpoint must be verified. Both use the endpoint's current signing key. Requires the webhooks scope.

tools.name: wait_for_assessment
tools.description:
Wait until a pending assessment is no longer pending, then return it.

Polls get_assessment at the interval the API's Retry-After asks for (at least once a second) until status is complete, partial or failed, or until timeout_seconds pass. When the time runs out the assessment is still pending: the result says so and carries the last answer, and you can call this tool again. A pending assessment has no recommendation; apply your own fallback until it settles. Requires the assess or history scope.
